# GreenGuard USA

> Pesticide-free mosquito control for Austin, TX and surrounding areas using
> CO2 mosquito traps (Biogents professional equipment). Service, rental, and
> equipment sales. Family-owned, serves the Austin metro within ~40 miles.

Phone: 512-560-4129
Email: admin@greenguard-usa.com
Book a free property assessment: https://www.greenguard-usa.com/book
Service area: Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Leander, Pflugerville,
Lakeway, Bee Cave, Westlake Hills, Dripping Springs, Buda, Kyle, Liberty Hill.

## How it works
- CO2 traps mimic human breath to attract and capture mosquitoes, no sprays:
  https://new.greenguard-usa.com/why-co2-mosquito-traps-work
- Science overview: https://new.greenguard-usa.com/mosquito-science
- Traps vs spraying comparison: https://www.greenguard-usa.com/compare

## Already own a mosquito trap? (service, refill, install)
GreenGuard services traps you already own. You do NOT have to buy equipment from
us. Monthly CO2 delivery, tank exchange, placement tuning, and maintenance for
Biogents / Mosqitter / compatible CO2 traps in the Austin metro. Details + booking:
https://www.greenguard-usa.com/biogents-trap-service-austin
Fast-path booking for existing owners: https://www.greenguard-usa.com/book?own=1
CO2 tank refill: any welding-supply, fire-extinguisher, homebrew, or paintball shop
fills a 20 lb CGA-320 cylinder for ~$20-35; or use GreenGuard monthly delivery.

## FAQ
https://www.greenguard-usa.com/faq

Safe for bees, butterflies, pets, and kids: traps target only host-seeking
mosquitoes. No barrier sprays required (optional barrier treatment available).
